title: Design System: Sherpas · Plan in Motion

display.purpose: Onboarding questions on the light world.

headline.purpose: Scene headlines on navy, white, accent highlights.

figure.purpose: The plan's numbers, sized per scene; also the wait game's distance counter.

title.purpose: Card titles: episode card, wait panel, advisor view.

label.purpose: Chips, counters, picker labels, meta. Sentence case.

gradients.name: cta
gradients.purpose: The one primary action per screen (pill, white text >=19px/600) and the start play disc.

gradients.name: start-veil
gradients.purpose: Overlay behind the start button on the stage.

shadows.name: row
shadows.purpose: Resting rows, selects, selected chips, round controls.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Hovered rows and the episode card.

shadows.name: dialog-navy
shadows.purpose: Explain dialog over a rgba(11,15,46,.78) scrim.

shadows.name: cta-inset
shadows.purpose: Highlight on the CTA gradient pill.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on light; on navy the outline takes the accent.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for lifts, scales and transitions; one orchestrated moment per transition.

motion.name: ease-panel
motion.purpose: App panel easing from the Sherpas app tokens.

motion.name: duration-lift
motion.purpose: Row lift, shadow and step-state transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Durations collapse to 0.01ms; the yak waits for the first jump.

components.name: CTA Pill
components.description: The one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-cta { background: linear-gradient(127deg, #948DF7 11%, #4565D6 119%); color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 80px; padding: 12px 28px; font: 600 19px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px 0 #B8C1E6; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4565D6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Every other affirmative action, light or navy.
components.css: .ds-solid { background: #4565D6; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 80px; padding: 10px 18px; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-solid:hover { background: #1C45D7; } .ds-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4565D6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (navy)
components.css: .ds-navy { background: #1C2140; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-ghost { background: transparent; color: #E0EEFF; border: 1px solid #2F365E; border-radius: 80px; padding: 10px 18px; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: #9EA6C4; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6586FC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Chips
components.description: Format and mode pickers in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; background: #EFF1F5; border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; } .ds-chip { border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 500 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5F6480; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #141419; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #FFFFFF; color: #141419; box-shadow: 0 6px 2px -4px #1414190A, inset 0 -1px 0 #14141933; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4565D6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Row
components.description: One-tap onboarding answer: icon tile, label, sub-label, key hint. Always one full-width column.
components.css: .ds-opt { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 14px; text-align: left; color: #141419; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E5EB; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 2px -4px #1414190A, inset 0 -1px 0 #14141933; padding: 10px 14px; font: 500 15px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.12s, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-opt:hover { border-color: #C6D2FD; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #0000000D, 0 8px 10px #0000001A; } .ds-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4565D6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-opt-ic { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: #EFF5FF; color: #4565D6; } .ds-opt-l { flex: 1; } .ds-opt-l small { display: block; margin-top: 0.3em; color: #5F6480; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.8em; } .ds-opt-k { font: 500 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #7F8399; border: 1px solid #E2E5EB; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.35em 0.55em; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #141419; border: 1px solid #E2E5EB; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7F8399; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4565D6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #EFF5FF; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Wordmark (masked PNG in the build), feature name after a hairline, pickers right.
components.css: .ds-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E5EB; } .ds-word { font: 600 20px Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #0E1C29; } .ds-feat { font: 500 15px Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #5F6480; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid #E2E5EB; }

components.name: Navy Tile
components.description: A plan figure on the navy stage; accent from the anchor. Figure shown is a placeholder, real ones come from the plan.
components.css: .ds-stage { --accent: #6586FC; background: radial-gradient(110% 90% at 18% 0%, #222852 0%, #161827 48%, #0B0F2E 100%); padding: 24px; border-radius: 26px; } .ds-tile { background: #1C2140; border: 1px solid #2F365E; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #E0EEFF; } .ds-big { font: 600 40px/0.92 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent); } .ds-tile p { margin: 10px 0 0; color: #9EA6C4; font: 13px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.description: Real preparation steps; current pulses, done fills with the anchor accent.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-wait { --accent: #61A9FA; background: #1C2140; border: 1px solid #2F365E; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 18px; color: #E0EEFF; width: 300px; } .ds-wait-t { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 17px Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-wait ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wait li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #9EA6C4; } .ds-wait li i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #4A5285; font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: transparent; } .ds-wait li.now, .ds-wait li.done { color: #E0EEFF; } .ds-wait li.now i { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-wait li.done i { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #0B0F2E; }

narrative.northStar: From the app to the summit
narrative.overview:
Plan in Motion is a Sherpas feature, not a brand of its own. The "sherpas" wordmark and the yak lead every surface; "Plan in Motion" is only the feature name, set quietly beside the wordmark. The system is Sherpas Wealth's own: palette, type, radii and shadows were extracted from sherpaswealth.com and app.sherpaswealth.com into `design/sherpas-tokens.css`, and the shipped player (`web/styles.css`) is the reference implementation.

There are two worlds, and every new surface lives in exactly one of them. The **light app world** is where people answer, choose and configure: a cool near-white frame, white raised rows with hairline borders and the app's soft offset shadow, ink text, brand blue for selection, focus and icons. It is quiet, exact and dense in the way a good form is. The **navy hero world** is where the plan is shown: the episode, the wait screen, video frames, slides. Navy deepening to midnight, ice-blue text, one bright accent, big Poppins figures, and the white yak. Moving from the first to the second is the system's one theatrical moment: the curtain drops to navy and the yak runs.

Rejected outright: a dark video player with one neon accent, a generic stepper form in a card, glassmorphism, gradient text.
keyCharacteristics: Two worlds: light app (asking) and navy hero (showing); never a muddy middle.
Poppins 600 at -0.02em for anything the eye should land on; Inter for everything else.
One accent colour at a time on navy, chosen by the viewer's answer.
One primary action per screen, as the lavender-to-blue pill.
Every figure comes from the plan; the design never decorates with fake numbers.
One Lucide line-icon family at 1.75 stroke.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: On navy, exactly one accent is live at a time, and it is the anchor colour. Status colours appear only where they carry meaning (bands, risk figures, best/worst bars).

rules.name: The Blue Means Act Rule
rules.body: On light, Sherpas Blue marks what is selected, focused or tappable. Do not use it for decoration or body text.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Poppins for what you read first, Inter for what you read next. No third family, no Poppins below 14px.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Stage type scales with `cqmin` but always has a px floor (`max(13px, …)`), so 9:16 on a small phone stays legible.

rules.name: The Lift On Intent Rule
rules.body: Rows rest at Row and rise to Pop with a 1px lift only on hover. Nothing floats at rest except the stage and the episode card.

dos: Do lead with the Sherpas wordmark and the yak; name the feature beside it, never instead of it.
Do link `design/sherpas-tokens.css` and reuse the role variables from `web/styles.css` (`--ink`, `--blue`, `--surface`, `--accent` …) instead of new hex values.
Do put asking in the light app world and showing in the navy hero world.
Do set titles, questions and figures in Poppins 600 at -0.02em (figures -0.035em, tabular) and everything else in Inter 400/500.
Do use the CTA gradient pill for one primary action per screen, white text at 19px+ weight 600; use the Sherpas Blue Solid pill (#4565D6) for every other action.
Do let the anchor answer drive `--accent` on navy through `data-anchor`.
Do use Lucide line icons at stroke 1.75 via `icon()` and `npm run icons`, in brand blue on light.
Do tint the yak and wordmark PNGs with `mask-image` and `currentColor`.
Do keep body contrast at 4.5:1 or better, give every stage size a px floor, and make every interaction work by keyboard and touch.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: transitions collapse, the yak waits for input. Motion uses `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` with one orchestrated moment per transition.
donts: Don't put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use gradient text, including the `--sw-gradient-stat-text` token in the tokens file.
Don't use glassmorphism; the `--sw-glass-*` tokens in the tokens file are recorded from the website, not for use.
Don't put the gradient on small buttons, on more than one action, or with text under 19px.
Don't invent or round figures, customers, prices or claims; every number shown comes from the plan.
Don't mix worlds: no white cards on navy scenes, no navy panels in light app screens.
Don't make motion the only carrier of meaning.
Don't add assets outside `web/` and `design/`; `npm run serve` and GitHub Pages serve only those.
